ZFIN curation records meox1 in somites at 5-9 somites (Kudoh screen) and in anterior segmental plate and somites at 5-9 somites (Nguyen et al.); somitic, not adaxial-specific.

gata1 (gata1a) marks the intermediate cell mass precursors, traced back to posterior-lateral mesoderm of the gastrula.
